patterns.purpose: Let the work establish trust before introducing services.
sections: Short practice introduction and dominant work
Practice statement and one contextual image
patterns.desktop: Seven-column lead image with a two-column caption; alternate image scales around a shared baseline.
patterns.mobile: One image per row; captions immediately follow their image.
patterns.conversion: View work first, then inquire with an understood scope.

patterns.purpose: Explain one project without turning it into a card collection.
patterns.desktop: A narrow reading column beside a wider media column.
patterns.mobile: Brief, establishing view, decisions, and detail views in that order.
patterns.conversion: Offer the next project and a distinct inquiry link.

patterns.purpose: Make a small service offering easy to compare.
patterns.desktop: Aligned, border-light service columns with the same information order.
patterns.mobile: Stack scopes with headings, then one inquiry form.
patterns.conversion: Show scope and exclusions before requesting contact.
